environment: Local Space Vite development server, Microsoft Edge, 1440x1000 viewport
workload: Three 24-step drags, zoom in/out, then 1500 ms to finish pending work per view
note: Frame intervals include the active interactions and settling period. This is a local browser measurement, not a guarantee for every device. Bitmap memory is separate from JS heap. Original dense-renderer drag runs stalled and were interrupted, so no percentage speedup is claimed.
